scripts.fmt: node_modules/.bin/oxfmt .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json package.json vite.config.ts tsconfig.json tsconfig.scripts.json scripts src
scripts.fmt:check: node_modules/.bin/oxfmt .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json package.json vite.config.ts tsconfig.json tsconfig.scripts.json scripts src --check
scripts.lint: vp lint -c .oxlintrc.json vite.config.ts scripts/*.ts src/main.ts src/timeline.ts src/scenes/*.ts src/engine/**/*.ts
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run fmt:check
